performance.type: CPU scene traversal. Includes hidden meshes and multiplies instanced triangle counts; not renderer calls, GPU memory or FPS.

performance.renovatedSceneScope: CPU scene traversal includes hidden food and instance-expanded triangles. Upgraded includes all projects/equipment, reputation level 5, first choice in every decor slot, Takeaway first, Takeaway counter and rain. performance.sampledFrameScope: Light quality, initial six-block station views and five story poses. Single-frame samples in software WebGL; not worst-case/device FPS.
